category: test double more orderly than the exchange
rule: charter s4 items 1-3; DVM-19; src/execution/protection.py:1794-1796 'positionRisk lags the fill'
summary: The Binance-semantics fake used by 30 test files has zero read lag: positions move in the same call as fill(), and by-id queries find an order immediately after placement; only a post-cancel algo lag exists and it is opt-in (3 files). Three escaped defects of this audit (G-0250, G-0253, G-0300) share this cause.
expected: Protection/reconcile/emergency-close suites run (by default or in a second pass) with a by-id not-found window after placement and lagging position reads after a fill.
actual: Lag-class behaviour is tested only where scripted; Demo showed -2013 for ~90 s on a just-placed NEW algo (DVM-19) and position reads lagging the fill.
impact: Green tests for code that closes a protected position or holds SAFE_MODE on a transient not-found/zero read, or treats a lagging zero as flat. Now: Demo noise/false SAFE_MODE. Mainnet: needless market closes or wrong FLAT transitions.
evidence: fake_binance_exchange.py:305 fill() -> _apply_position_delta; :793-819 snapshot_positions reads self.positions; :569/:593 query_* read open_orders/open_algos directly; :201/:207 algo_cancel_query_lag default timedelta(0); :383-392 fail_next never changes state.
reproduction: Read the cited lines; tmp/exec_protection/probe_lag.py shows the coordinator with an injected lag.
why_tests_miss: The fake is consistent by construction.
recommendation: Add a read-lag mode to the fake and run the protection, reconcile and emergency-close suites with it; label the zero-lag default [ASSUMED].

category: CI capacity / only place PostgreSQL tests run
rule: AGENTS.md Tests (sequential suite is the CI form); G-1508
summary: The CI test job runs the full suite sequentially with PostgreSQL under timeout-minutes: 30 (unchanged since 2026-10-01). The project measured ~24 min for 10,412 tests; the suite is now ~18,300 tests (x1.76), no pytest-timeout is installed, and CI runs only on master pushes/PRs. No CI result is recorded anywhere, so it is unproven that the 872 PostgreSQL cases ran on any commit since 2026-10-20.
expected: Recorded CI evidence that the full sequential suite including *_pg tests completed on the commit used by the Demo runs.
actual: No CI run result in the repo; linear scaling gives ~42 min on the dev machine, so the job likely times out.
impact: If confirmed, database-semantics gates (exactly-once placement, approval consume, reservations, SAFE_MODE persistence, intent recovery; G-1901) ran nowhere since 2026-10-20.
evidence: ci.yml:30 timeout-minutes: 30; ci.yml:72-73 sequential pytest with TEST_DATABASE_URL; ci.yml:8-12 master only; .planning/quick/261020-xd4-*/xdist-measurements.txt 'seq ~24 min (10412 tests)'; TODO.md:72 17380 passed + 915 skipped + 3 xfailed.
reproduction: Owner: read duration/conclusion of the test job for the 2026-11-15 master push (PR #3); or time the sequential suite with TEST_DATABASE_URL.
why_tests_miss: Process; tests/test_deploy_workflows.py:87 only checks that a timeout-minutes exists.
recommendation: Record CI run id/duration/result per merge; raise the timeout or use -n in CI; add pytest-timeout; run CI on develop pushes.

component: src/core purity guard; wall-clock and no-float guard lists
rule: AGENTS.md 'Invariants that are machine-enforced' (core purity incl. SDK/network, no wall clock, Decimal-only)
summary: The only src/core import guard checks a fixed list of 5 files (not pivots.py, _decimal.py) against roots {polars,pandas,numpy,binance,sqlalchemy,pydantic}; root matching lets binance_sdk_*, binance_common, httpx, websockets, telegram, psycopg, duckdb, socket, src.adapters and src.db through. No wall-clock guard covers any src/core or src/research module; src/risk/cost_guards.py and live_commission.py are in no float guard. All are clean today.
expected: Glob-discovered guards with a complete forbidden set, as for src/backtest, src/analytics and src/live.
actual: A future SDK/network/clock import into src/core/pivots.py or a new core module passes CI.
impact: The deterministic no-AI core loses its automatic fence for part of the package.
evidence: tests/test_core_tracer.py:396 fixed fname tuple; probe tmp/test_effectiveness_ci/probe_core_guard.out (caught=False for SDK/network/DB imports); probe_guard_scope.out (core 0/7 wall-clock guarded).
why_tests_miss: The guard predates pivots.py and is a fixed list.
recommendation: Apply tests/test_analytics_purity.find_violations by glob to src/core and src/risk; add SDK/network roots.
